featured_reviews.name: shruti vinod
featured_reviews.review_text:
I want to begin by sharing that my earlier experience at Usha Diagnostic Center in August for an MRI was very positive. At that time, the staff were knowledgeable, polite, and genuinely helpful, which is why I chose this center again for my sonography.

However, my recent experience with the female radiologist was extremely upsetting and unprofessional. She arrived 35 minutes late, and since eight patients were already waiting, I ended up waiting almost 1.5 hours in total. When my turn finally came, she did not even look at my medical file. She briefly glanced at the receipt, immediately said she would not do the scan, spoke rudely, muttered something, and walked out of the room while I was already lying down for the procedure. I was completely shocked and distressed by her behavior.

The staff then told me that she wanted the same scan details rewritten on a different doctor’s letterhead and even asked for my Aadhaar card to be stamped by my gynecologist, which I found very strange and unreasonable. None of these requirements were communicated to me beforehand — otherwise, I would never have wasted 1.5 hours waiting there.

Importantly, the prescription/receipt itself was not the issue, because I later used the same receipt and successfully completed my sonography at another diagnostic center in Airoli without any problem. This made it clear that the refusal was not medically justified.

After this incident, Prakash from customer care contacted me, sincerely apologized, assured me that action would be taken against the concerned radiologist, and even offered to reschedule my scan with another doctor. I appreciated this follow-up, though I did not return since my scan was already done elsewhere.

Overall, Usha Diagnostics has good facilities and generally helpful staff, but I would strongly advise patients to avoid this particular female radiologist to prevent a similar unpleasant experience.

When in doubt, don't delay. Consult your doctor and get tested if advised.
